titles.defaultLanguage: Language for cards where the source provides no language

titles.proxyImages: Load images of this API through the backend (for hosts without CORS headers)
titles.cardFacesDataListField: List of card faces, e.g. card_faces on Scryfall. Each face with an image becomes its own match.

connectedCards.dataListFieldTitle: List inside a match, e.g. all_parts on Scryfall
connectedCards.nameFieldTitle: Name of each entry, searched across all active APIs
connectedCards.linkFieldTitle: Optional: link to the exact object (same format as a match)
connectedCards.typeFieldTitle: Optional: type of each entry, e.g. type_line
connectedCards.title: Connected Cards
connectedCards.titleTooltip: Each entry of a list becomes its own card (count 1), searched across all active APIs

titles.parameterMap: Each entry becomes an input field. Leave empty if the source needs no input
titles.linkPattern: Regex with named groups, e.g. (?<id>\d+). The groups fill {id} etc. in the Base URL; with Link Pattern or Credential the backend fetches the source
titles.followInputRedirects: If the link does not match the pattern, follow its redirects first (short and share links)
titles.credential: Name of a credential stored by the server operator (e.g. reddit). Cookie or token stay on the server and are only sent to the matching host
titles.imageUrlPattern: Regex on the image URL read. If it does not match, the entry is dropped (e.g. videos, subfolders)
titles.imageUrlReplacement: Replacement for the pattern, groups as $1, e.g. https://i.redd.it/$1
titles.namePattern: Regex on the name read, e.g. \.\w+$ for the file extension
titles.nameReplacement: Replacement for the pattern, empty = remove

titles.linkPattern: Regex for deck links; the group (?<id>...) provides the deck ID
titles.entryListFields: Paths to the card lists, comma-separated. "*" = all values of an object, "Sideboard=path" assigns the list to a board
titles.numberField: Collector number, only together with set
titles.boardField: Category or categories of an entry, text or list
titles.optionalBoards: Boards that are only loaded on request, comma-separated (for text: section headers)

s1.title: Enter your decklist
s1.content: Paste or type your deck here, one card per line with the count first, for example "4 Lightning Bolt". Exports from the common deckbuilders work as they are.

s2.title: Tokens & Extras
s2.content: When this is checked, tokens, emblems and other extras your cards create are added as separate cards.

s3.title: Search the images
s3.content: Analyze Deck searches all active sources for every card. The results show up in the grid as they arrive.

s4.title: Or import a deck
s4.content: Paste a deck link or ID and press Load Deck, or type a deck name and use Search by Name. Before an imported deck replaces your list, the current state is saved as a snapshot.

s5.title: Add single cards
s5.content: Add your own image, search a gallery, or paste a list of image links to add cards one by one.

s6.title: Your deck
s6.content: Every card gets a tile. Click a tile to pick a different image, use + and − to change the count.

s7.title: Print it
s7.content: When you are happy with the selection, Create PDF builds a printable sheet of all cards.

s1.title: Choose your sources
s1.content: Each entry is a source the search asks for card images. Check or uncheck single sources, or click a category to switch all of its sources at once.

s2.title: Manage sources
s2.content: The gear opens the source manager. There you can add new sources, edit existing ones or test them.

s3.title: Shared search cache
s3.content: Reuses search results other users already found, which is much faster. Uncheck it to always ask the sources yourself, for example after changing a source.

s4.title: Galleries
s4.content: Gallery Search browses image galleries that are not part of the regular card search.

s5.title: Deck sources
s5.content: This gear manages the deckbuilder sites decks can be imported from.

s1.title: View settings
s1.content: Unique Prints shows one tile per copy, so every copy can get its own image. Show Image Info adds size and quality details to each tile.

s2.title: Grid size
s2.content: Makes the tiles in the grid bigger or smaller. This only changes the view, not the PDF.

s3.title: Pick and crop images
s3.content: Click a tile to see all images found for that card and choose another one. Your own images can be cropped again with the crop button on their tile.

s4.title: Print settings
s4.content: Card size, margins, cut lines, rounded corners and the maximum image resolution are set here. The preview shows how a page will look.

s1.title: Downloads and caches
s1.content: These bubbles show what is happening in the background: waiting and active downloads and images being loaded from the cache. Click one to see the queue.

s2.title: Search cache
s2.content: Search results are kept in your browser, so searching the same card again is instant. Click to see or delete stored searches.

s3.title: Image cache
s3.content: Downloaded images are stored in your browser too. The bar shows how full the image cache is; click it to clean up.

s4.title: Reset deck
s4.content: Clears the decklist, results and selection. You will be asked before anything is removed.

s5.title: Snapshots
s5.content: Snapshots are also stored in this browser. Delete old ones here to free space.

s1.title: Language filter
s1.content: Uncheck a language to hide its images. Hold an entry for 2 seconds to show only that language.

s2.title: Priority
s2.content: Drag entries to reorder them. The order decides which image is picked automatically: the top entry wins, the others are the fallback. The number shows each entry's rank.

s3.title: Source filter
s3.content: Works the same way for sources: hide sources, hold to show only one, drag to set which source is preferred.

s4.title: Effect on your deck
s4.content: A card you picked by hand stays picked as long as it matches the filters. Tiles without any matching image are marked. The image selection dialog has the same filters.

s1.title: Snapshots
s1.content: A snapshot stores your whole work: the decklist, the images you picked, active sources, filters and print settings. Snapshots are kept in this browser. After a reload, "Restore last session" brings back where you left off.

s2.title: Save
s2.content: Saves the current state. A snapshot is also made automatically when you create a PDF and before an imported deck replaces your list.

s3.title: Load and manage
s3.content: Click a snapshot to load it. The buttons next to it overwrite it with the current state, rename or delete it. Snapshots of a created PDF can download it again while it is available.
